question: If a person travels a certain distance at a speed of 10 km/h, and returns through the same route at a speed of 20 km/h, then what will be the average speed during the whole journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal distances covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y)

Here, forward speed x = 10 km/h and return speed y = 20 km/h.

Average speed = (2 × 10 × 20) ÷ (10 + 20) = 400 ÷ 30 = 40/3 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 40/3 km/h.**
